description: This file provides an implementation of syslog functions for Windows, interfacing with the Windows Event Log API. It includes functions to open a log connection and send log messages with formatting, handling internal string manipulations and external event reporting.

methods.name: void openlog(const char * ident,int logopt UNUSED,int facility UNUSED)
methods.description: Initializes the event log handle if not already opened by registering with the Windows Event Log system using the provided identifier.

methods.name: void syslog(int priority,const char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Formats and sends a log message to the Windows Event Log, handling string formatting, substitution of '%1', and selecting log type based on priority.

ctags.name: openlog
ctags.pattern: /^void openlog(const char *ident, int logopt UNUSED, int facility UNUSED)$/
ctags.signature: (const char * ident,int logopt UNUSED,int facility UNUSED)
